value.rationale: A natural complete infinite-parameter cone of time-lag majority systems, including nondominant clover recurrences of arbitrarily large depth, is proved to have exactly two basins, no nontrivial cycles, and a decision fixed at the first update; this sharply improves the source’s topology-only exponential attractor bounds and gives a weight-independent exact settling-time statistic and full uniform-weight histogram. The finite settling upper bound is sharp and the nonmonotone two-cycle demonstrates a genuine dynamical boundary, rather than a mere arithmetic recomputation.
